intro.title: The process can be hard to make sense of.
intro.body: A refugee claim can involve unfamiliar documents, important deadlines and several different organizations. I bring the information together step by step, to help you understand what may happen and prepare for what comes next.

journey.title: Move forward one step at a time
journey.intro: Every journey is different, but a few broad steps can help you find where you are and understand what comes next.

steps.title: Understand your options
steps.description: Learn what a claim involves and where to find reliable information.

steps.title: Prepare your information
steps.description: Organize your documents, your important dates and your story.

steps.title: Start the claim
steps.description: Understand the forms, the instructions and the organizations involved.

steps.title: Prepare for the hearing
steps.description: Learn about evidence, representation and how the hearing works.

steps.title: After the decision
steps.description: Explore the next steps and the resources for settling in.

services.title: Services organized around your needs
services.intro: Go straight to the information and resources that are most useful during the refugee claim journey.

cards.title: Understand the process
cards.description: A clear overview of the steps, the organizations involved and the terms that matter.

cards.title: Get prepared
cards.description: General guidance for organizing your documents, your information and your important dates.

cards.title: Find resources
cards.description: Links to authorized legal help, public bodies and community support.

story.title: Built with lived experience in mind
story.body: This platform is shaped by the difficulties people face when trying to understand a process that is new and complex. My goal is to make the information clearer, more respectful and easier to navigate.
story.imageNote: Portrait or a moment of support

closing.title: You don't need to understand everything today.
closing.body: Start by exploring the information that best matches where you are right now.

footer.tagline: General, accessible information to help you better understand the refugee claim journey in Canada.
footer.legal: This site provides general information and is not a substitute for advice from a lawyer or an authorized representative. It does not determine eligibility for refugee protection. Rules, procedures and timelines may change.
